scope: Fresh complete-domain move-choice recomputation; every preferred White tie and every legal Black reply; D4 deduplication; terminal and degenerate exclusions at every ply. Counts are positions on cycles, not positions that can reach cycles.
terminalDefinition: Central bishop diagonally adjacent to knight, or degenerate A/B/C; stop at either side to move. This is an audit terminal, not a support declaration.
